newsitem.title: USA: Delta expands code share with two lines.
newsitem.headline: Delta expands code share with two lines.

text.p: Delta Air Lines Inc, Swissair and Austrian Airlines said Thursday they were expanding their code-share relationship to include a joint nonstop service flight from Washington, D.C., to Zurich.
Beginning April 1, Delta and Swissair will purchase seats on Austrian's A310 wide-body aircraft daily flights, they said.

The airlines said the trilateral code share flight will replace the code share flight operated by them from Washington's Dulles International Airport to Geneva and on to Vienna. That flight, which started in November 1994, will be discontinued March 30, 1997, they said.
Delta's Flight 2772 to Zurich will operate daily, they added.
